answer_4.quote: To measure the quality of generated contents from DCE-LLM, we conduct a human evaluation of both explanations and repaired code. Three experienced programmers serve as voluntary annotators...
answer_4.guideline: For explanations, annotators rate each output as worse, similar, or better than the baseline; for repaired code, they check if it maintains the same function and if all dead code is removed.
